correctness.rationale: The source Corollary 3.3 fully characterizes the exceptional indices. The proof independently reconstructs all four 16-site patterns, determines all eight admissible block transitions with their frequencies using an exact Thue–Morse neighbor correlation recurrence, and converts the resulting gap counts into the six asymptotic probabilities. All errors are O(log N) through binary recurrence iteration and the geometric decomposition of the exceptional set. Finite direct-partition and block computations validate the recurrence implementation without substituting for this infinite proof.

value.rationale: The original paper explicitly studies the six gap lengths but does not quantify their frequencies, and raises further questions about the order of these gaps. This first-order distribution is a natural complete statistic: the listed allowed lengths alone do not determine any of the six exact probabilities, and the logarithmic discrepancy supplies quantitative control. The exact mean and nonzero variance provide interpretable structural information independent of a general downstream theorem.
